svg.title: Hub and spoke network for the example deployment
svg.desc: A hub virtual network holds Azure Firewall, a VPN or ExpressRoute gateway and a DNS Private Resolver. The gateway connects the hub to the on-premises datacenter, and the firewall sends internet traffic out. Five spoke virtual networks are each peered to the hub: production operations, production engineering, production finance, development and test. Each spoke has a session host subnet and a private endpoint subnet.
svg.text: Hub and spoke network for the example deployment
Spokes are not connected to each other. Traffic between them goes through the hub with explicit routes and policy.
